```{r}
# Load dataset mtcars
data(mtcars)

# Convert variables into qualitative variables & display table of data
mtcars$am <- factor(mtcars$am,
                    levels = c(0, 1),
                    labels = c("Automatic", "Manual"))

table(mtcars$am)

mtcars$mpg_group <- cut(mtcars$mpg,
                        breaks = c(0, 20, 30, 40),
                        labels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"))

table(mtcars$mpg_group)

# Rename categories
levels(mtcars$am) <- c("Automatic", "Manual")

# Quantitative variables
summary(mtcars$mpg)
summary(mtcars$hp)

# Mean and std deviation
mean(mtcars$mpg)
sd(mtcars$mpg)

mean(mtcars$hp)
sd(mtcars$hp)

# Qualitative variables
table(mtcars$cyl)
table(mtcars$am)

# Descriptive stats

# HP : weight ratio
mtcars$hp_to_weight <- mtcars$hp / mtcars$wt

# MPG category
mtcars$mpg_category <- ifelse(mtcars$mpg > 20,
                              "Fuel Efficient",
                              "Less Efficient")

# Convert to factor
mtcars$mpg_category <- as.factor(mtcars$mpg_category)

# View transformed variables
head(mtcars)

#Plot Quantitative Variable

# Histogram of MPG
hist(mtcars$mpg,
     main = "Distribution of MPG",
     xlab = "Miles Per Gallon",
     col = "lightblue",
     border = "black")

# Scatterplot of horsepower vs MPG
plot(mtcars$hp, mtcars$mpg,
     main = "Horsepower vs MPG",
     xlab = "Horsepower",
     ylab = "Miles Per Gallon",
     pch = 19,
     col = "red")
```
